Mint Soda Fairy Princess.
Turquoise Mint Fairy Lolita, whimsical fairycore fashion, elegant lace details, beautiful natural lighting, full body, highly detailed fabrics.

A charming young woman wearing a soft ivory cable-knit cardigan with delicate lace trim, pearl buttons, oversized balloon sleeves, and a slightly cropped silhouette. The cardigan feels cozy and substantial while maintaining a graceful fairycore aesthetic.

Beneath the cardigan is a short turquoise-blue and mint-green lolita-inspired dress. The skirt features a soft bell-shaped silhouette with lightweight layered lace, scalloped lace edging, subtle floral embroidery, airy gathered ruffles, and translucent lace accents with tiny white polka dots.

A small number of turquoise and mint ribbon bows decorate the waist and skirt, preserving a sweet lolita appearance without excessive ornamentation.

A soft cream tulle underskirt is visible evenly around the hem, creating a light layered silhouette with clear color separation between ivory, turquoise, mint, and cream. The skirt has an even hemline with no train, no overskirt, and no extended back layer.

She wears elegant ivory lace thigh-high stockings and cream mary jane shoes decorated with small turquoise ribbon bows.

The palette is inspired by turquoise gemstones, mint sorbet, soft cream flowers, and delicate fairy lights, creating a bright, cheerful, and refined fairy-lolita atmosphere.

A woman wearing a tall, transparent, ice-like crown stands beside a white birch trunk in a snow-covered forest. Her figure occupies the center and left of the vertical image, while the sharply defined trunk rises just right of center. One hand rests against the bark near her shoulder; the other lies lower against the trunk at her waist. She faces the viewer with her head slightly tilted, dark hair loosely gathered beneath the crown, and lips gently parted.
